title: {{name}} and the Little Star
text:
{{name}} looked up at the night sky. The stars were so bright and big. {{name}} wanted to fly up to them. So {{name}} made a rocket from a big box. The rocket was red and yellow.

Then {{name}} jumped in and counted down. Three, two, one! The rocket went up fast. {{name}} flew past the moon. The moon was white and round.

Soon {{name}} saw a little star. But the star was sad. It could not shine. "I lost my light," the star said.

{{name}} wanted to help. They looked all around the dark sky. At last they found the light behind a cloud. {{name}} gave it back to the star.

The little star was so happy now. It started to shine again. The star said, "Thank you, my friend!" {{name}} smiled and waved.

Then {{name}} flew back home in the red rocket. The night sky was full of light. Every star looked bright and warm. {{name}} went to bed with a big smile. It was the best day ever.

questions.prompt: What did {{name}} make to fly to the stars?
options: A rocket from a big box

questions.prompt: Why was the little star sad?
How did {{name}} feel at the end of the story?
